name: Today (live)
desc: The live X3+ page: the chart on cream over the dark ray ground; the fight bill on red and black dot screens; the S3 tape on a green ticket; the proof on a cream ticket.

name: T1 Ringside (3D, comic ink)
desc: seedream-50-pro. The coin spins over the ropes; the hit-rate chart drawn on the ring canvas, grid lines as ropes, the coin line a gold rope; founders on corner cards. Bill in the painted arena, tape on the weigh-in curtain, proof on the canvas, Target hits at the range.

name: T2 Test your skill (pop art)
desc: gpt-image-2. The fairground booth opens it; the chart hangs on its velvet backboard; each AI swings a drawn high striker, the puck at its hit rate, gold line = the coin. Gloves collide over the bill, the tape a pop page, the proof under searchlights, Target hits at the shooting gallery.

name: T3 The house (noir, one gold)
desc: seedream-50-pro. Desk or dice table? The chart inked on the felt, the leader in gold; each record a stack of chips, one per 5%, a coin is 10 chips. Bill on the scorekeeper's table, tape as the judges' scorecard, Target hits at the night range.

name: T4 Chalk and print (anime cel + risograph)
desc: gpt-image-2. After class: the chart chalked on the board, the founders taped up as photos. Leaderboard in two-colour riso: red and green gloves on poster stock, the tape printed on the pasted fight poster (its red head band and green foot band), targets in red ink off register.
